text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The Satono family's dream was to
produce an
illustrious racer capable of
winning G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was young, I raced in the
hopes of
becoming that illustrious
runner.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now, having won a G1 race in the
Twinkle Series,
today I embark on a new
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Today,
I challenge illustrious runners I've
aspired
to be like—as their rival.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And also you, who has been by my side
since the
day we met.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even if you started running before me...
Even if
the races we entered and the
goals we strived for
differed...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Today I will share the turf with the
people I've always looked up to. I've
dreamed of this moment
before ever
enrolling at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It was through our rivalry that I was able
to reach
this point.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But only one of us can be crowned the
winner!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose! Not to you! Not to
McQueen! And
not to Teio either!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll triumph and make my family's
dream—my
dream—come true!
